notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least five charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}{R}{R}.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by paying {2}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Blood tokens, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
